_comment: Ported 2026-09-16 from the source project. families_by_page_type scopes which invariant families run per page type. IMG/LAYOUT/NAV are BLOCKING; SEM/SCHEMA/CSS/DUP/A11Y/FORM enter ADVISORY until they have passed their fixtures AND produced zero false reports across one full cluster - the same promotion rule the source harness uses. (2026-09-26: what blocks is no longer read off the family. The source of truth is `promotions` below together with each check's registered `severity` - a scope `all` entry for every blocking check, a scope `new-pages` entry for an advisory check that blocks on project 5 pages only; see `_promotions_comment`.) Registering a check is not wiring it in: in the source project the A11Y family was registered and declared blocking a full day before it appeared here, so it examined ZERO pages while reporting as a shipped gate (Guard 2 in build_scorecard.mjs is what caught it). meta.spec.ts now asserts the symmetric difference between registered families and families named here is empty. DUP's sibling set is every built page (lib/dupCorpus.ts siblingSlugsFor), never 'targets of the same page type', so no page type compares against nothing. Foundation is a verbatim migration of WordPress markup: many failures are expected on migrated bodies and form the baseline for projects 3 and 4; failures caused by the shell (SiteHeader/SiteFooter/Breadcrumb/BaseLayout/PuppyList/ContactForm) are fixed here. `corpus: true` marks the frozen benchmark sample - one page per page type - so the quality trend does not depend on which pages happened to be built that month.
_deferred_comment: Controller decision 2026-09-16. These checks are registered, wired and passing their fixture pairs, but the convention they encode does not exist on Foundation's verbatim WordPress markup, so they examine zero nodes on every built page. Guard 2 in build_scorecard.mjs exempts them from the zero-examined FAIL and PRINTS them as DEFERRED with the reason, so the scorecard is never silent about them. meta.spec.ts asserts every id here is a registered check that still passes both fixtures AND that it examined zero nodes in the latest raw run, so a deferral can never hide a dead check nor outlive the condition that justified it. Every rationale must end with its promotion condition ('remove this entry when ...').
_promoted_comment: Not the promotion record (that is `promotions`, `_promotions_comment`): this is the history of the emptied `_deferred` list. Emptied 2026-09-19, Task 21. All three entries met the promotion condition each of them stated: the page that carries the conventions is src/pages/kit-preview/ (page_type `preview` below), not a real page — project 4 does not mount the kit on the real pages until its build 4, so the plan's Task 21 step 1, which would have put a CounterStrip and an InfoCard on the homepage, is superseded (spec §11 amendment 6). kit-preview ships the counter strip, the two .stmt-label cards and one specimen section whose H3 owns a .sec-img, so each check now examines more than zero nodes and Guard 2 in build_scorecard.mjs judges them like every other check. kit-preview is `corpus: false` on purpose: it is a specimen page, not a sample of the shipped site, and letting it into the frozen benchmark would move the quality trend by a page no reader ever opens. The entry stays for as long as the kit lives only on the preview — when project 4 mounts the kit on real pages, the real pages become the subjects and this one stops being the only one.

pending_page_types.comparison: Project 5 builds comparison pages and none is built yet. Declared now so the first one is examined by every family the day it lands, instead of by whatever was remembered then. Remove this entry when the first comparison page is added to `pages` (tests/py/test_targets_coverage.py fails until you do).

_promotions_comment: Added 2026-09-26 (parity plan Task 14). `promotions` is the record the _comment's promotion rule never had: every check whose registered severity is `blocking` has a scope `all` entry, and a scope `new-pages` entry makes an ADVISORY check block on project 5 pages only — a `new_page_rule.page_types` page that is not in `new_page_rule.built_before`, does not start with `excluded_prefix`, and is in data/facts/rebuilt.json OR (with `or_board_approved`) has a data/boards/<slug_file>.json carrying `approval` or `approval_previous` - so the promoted checks block from board approval on, and a legacy city page with no board stays advisory (tests/render/lib/promotions.ts; scripts/render_baseline.py mirrors it for the baseline table). `page_types`, `built_before` and `excluded_prefix` are scripts/family_rules.py's NEW_FAMILY_PAGE_TYPES, BUILT_BEFORE_SYSTEM_GAPS and `_` fixture prefix, pinned by tests/py/test_targets_coverage.py. Not to be confused with `_promoted_comment`, which records the emptied deferral list. meta.spec.ts fails a blocking check with no entry, an entry whose scope contradicts the registry, and any entry with a false report.
